logp.method_description: A water–octanol distribution coefficient (log D) was determined by UV–vis absorption spectroscopy. Solid ruthenium complexes (0.4–0.5 mg) were dissolved in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (6.0 mL) and octanol (6.0 mL). The mixture was stirred vigorously for 3 h and allowed to settle for 1 h at room temperature. Each phase was transferred to a 1.0 cm × 1.0 cm cuvette, and the absorption spectrum was measured. The concentration of the solution was calculated based on the λmax of the MLCT band for complexes 1 and 3. For complex 2, concentrations were calculated based on the absorption at 459 nm for the aqueous phase and 490 nm for the octanol phase. The log D value was calculated according to the following equation: log D = log([Ru]octanol / [Ru]water) where [Ru]octanol and [Ru]water are the concentrations of ruthenium complexes in the octanol and water phases, respectively.
